subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the afterimage in the restricted area

722360101.text: Hmph. This is the third group of people you've sent here on Enkanomiya's last day.

722360102.text: If you want to collect the experimental records, then I have nothing to say to you. Perhaps if you can convince the Erebos and Sangonomiya Factions to cease their squabbling, we may yet discuss this.

722360103.text: In any case, I'm on Sangonomiya's side. It's better that these records remain forever buried here in the darkness.

722360105.text: What? You're not here to retrieve them? Then leave.

722360106.text: But that said, no ordinary person should have been able to enter this place. Are you a Jibashiri? Or were you sent here by Sangonomiya to silence us?

722360108.text: Well, aren't you the bright spark?

722360110.text: We're here to watch you work.

722360112.text: We're here to check on the measures you've taken to ensure the security of the records.

722360113.text: ...Whatever the case, your ability to get here indicates that you are no ordinary person. But I don't care whose side you're on. Leave this place — better sooner than later.

722360114.text: I've placed the records deep within the site, and the way can only be opened by activating an elemental monument. That will require a large amount of elemental energy.

722360115.text: Once everyone leaves Byakuyakoku, the Bathysmal Vishaps will be let loose. These have been raised to react to a special kind of elemental energy.

722360116.text: The Bathysmal Vishaps here are all of an enhanced variety, and they have a very high chance of passing their unique traits on their offspring. In a few years, this place will be swarming with powerful Bathysmal Vishaps.

722360117.text: As such, the records shall be safe as can be.

722360118.text: Wouldn't it be safer to just have the records burnt?

722360119.text: That was the option that I favored, but our research team is split, and it's not as if I don't understand the other perspectives.

722360120.text: "We're saving Watatsumi! We're heroes!" "Agh, we're going to be the villains in this story, aren't we..." Both these views have merit.

722360121.text: And besides, leaving the truth to a generation that can forgive us for what we've done... That is an option that I can also accept.

722360122.text: Looking at you, you must either be a Jibashiri or one of Sangonomiya's retainers.

722360123.text: Tell the higher-ups this: that Michiya will remain in the restricted zone until the moment of departure comes to ensure that no one else approaches the area.

722360124.text: So that makes you Michiya, then?

722360125.text: Mmhmm... Although I'll probably have to change my name once we get up above the surface to start a new life. Still, our wrongdoings are not so easily wiped away.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the experimental records in the experimental site

722369901.text: You've gotten better at pulling the wool over someone's eyes again, huh?

722369902.text: What was he talking about just now, anyway? Something about lighting the elemental monument up to obtain the records.

722369903.text: The monument will summon dangerous Bathysmal Vishaps, though, so we should prepare ourselves first!
